Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying {1}{U}, causing it to enter (with an additional Illusion type and triggered ability) as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.

Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.

At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
